description: This file defines the LayoutTestFinder class, which manages locating, filtering, and sharding layout tests for a web rendering test framework. It includes methods for reading test lists, filtering by timing data, and handling test sharding.

classes.name: LayoutTestFinder
classes.description: Class responsible for discovering, filtering, and sharding layout tests based on various criteria such as timing data and command-line options.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LayoutTestFinder with port and options.

methods.name: find_tests
methods.description: Finds tests based on arguments, test list files, and fastest percentile filtering.

methods.name: _times_trie
methods.description: Retrieves timing data trie from the filesystem.

methods.name: _fastest_tests
methods.description: Selects the fastest tests based on timing data and percentile.

methods.name: _strip_test_dir_prefixes
methods.description: Removes known directory prefixes from test paths.

methods.name: _strip_test_dir_prefix
methods.description: Removes specific directory prefix from a single test path.

methods.name: _read_test_names_from_file
methods.description: Reads test names from specified files, handling comments and path separators.

methods.name: _strip_comments
methods.description: Removes comments and extra whitespace from a line.

methods.name: skip_tests
methods.description: Determines which tests to skip based on expectations and options.

methods.name: split_into_chunks
methods.description: Splits test list into chunks for sharding based on options.

methods.name: _split_into_chunks
methods.description: Helper for dividing tests into specified shard chunks.
